required_facts.fact: Moderating a community at this scale is time-consuming.

We also run “shameless-promotion” channels, and as the community grew, I introduced [rules and message templates](https://alexeygrigorev.notion.site/Shameless-channels-template-f565ac6aa2064f7190382f2ffd82c876) for posti
I had to manually delete messages that violated the rules and send DMs explaining the reasons to those people.

It quickly became impractical because it required a lot of manual steps That is what pushed me to build an automation tool that could delete messages violating the rules and send a direct message explaining why.
The number of messages deleted in the past week, grouped by reaction type.
Without AuTomator, deleting these messages and sending direct messages with an explanation would all have been manual work.
That is why I built the [AuTomator bot](https://github.com/alexeygrigorev/au-tomator-lambda) back in June 2022 and kept adding features as new needs came up.
Recently, the bot broke, and I fixed it using Claude Code, which saved me at least two hours of debugging.
In this post, I walk through how the bot is built and how I used AI to diagnose and fix it.
It is split into three Lambdas, each with a clear responsibility.
